Indian Debt Funds Sell Bonds After RBI Policy Shift

Indian debt funds sold a net ₹51 billion ($527.08 million) of government bonds in the three trading sessions following the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) policy shift and rate increase. This follows a larger selloff of ₹378 billion in government bonds by asset managers during July-September. Mutual funds are expected to continue selling government bonds.
